title: Axis Titanium Smart Traveler credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A travel-focused credit card that rewards travel and everyday spends with Axis eDGE Reward Points, fuel surcharge waivers and travel-friendly perks like dining offers and big-purchase EMI conversions.
